paper_title: Results of a Search for Paraphotons with Intense X-ray Beams at SPring-8
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing angle chi (dimensionless), plotted directly on y-axis
notes: Light-shining-through-wall paraphoton search using intense X-ray beams at SPring-8 BL19LXU. Final combined 95% C.L. limit is chi < 8.06e-5, valid over 0.04 eV < m_gamma' < 26 keV (encoded as a flat two-point bound over the stated mass range). Below ~5 eV the limit has oscillatory (spiky) structure per measurement, but the combined result quoted by the authors is the mass-independent value chi_worst + Delta_chi = 8.06e-5. No DM density assumption (laboratory LSW experiment, not a haloscope). | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 40)) | Vision: Figure 4 shows the 95% C.L. upper limit on paraphoton kinetic mixing chi vs mass (blue 'our experiment' curve, hatched side excluded).
